newsitem.title: UK: Shell may have N.Sea oil discovery - report.
newsitem.headline: Shell may have N.Sea oil discovery - report.

text.p: Shell UK may have made a new discovery in a well it is drilling in North Sea block 211-23a-13, consultants Arthur Andersen said in a weekly report.
They said the well, located in the northern sector of the North Sea, was drilling to the west of Dunlin and close to block 211/23-5 which encountered oil shows. Shell is operating a tight hole.
Andersen said it had recently been reported that the government had given approval for a pipeline between the rig and the MV Crystal Sea floating platform.
"This suggests that a test could be taking place," the report said.
